stories.title: Cazas de Finlandia y Suecia interceptan aviones de combate rusos en el Báltico

en.title: Fighter jets from Finland and Sweden intercept Russian combat aircraft in the Baltic
en.summary: Finnish and Swedish quick-reaction fighter jets intercepted a Russian military formation over international airspace in the Baltic Sea on Thursday, consisting of a Tu-134 transport aircraft and MiG-31 and Su-30 fighters. This marked the first joint operational identification mission between the two Nordic countries.

stories.title: La Justicia tailandesa mantiene la cadena perpetua para Daniel Sancho

en.title: Thai court upholds life sentence for Daniel Sancho
en.summary: A Thai provincial court has rejected appeals and maintained a life sentence against Daniel Sancho for the premeditated murder of Colombian Edwin Arrieta. The court ruling was delivered in a closed hearing with only tribunal-invited participants present.

stories.title: La tensa espera de Maricarmen en el hospital y el misterio de su destino: "No he podido defender mi casa, pero sí he luchado"

en.title: Maricarmen's tense wait in hospital and the mystery of her future: "I couldn't defend my house, but I did fight"
en.summary: A woman remains hospitalized while deciding whether to leave with relatives or accept a place at a Madrid municipal residence. She reflects on her situation regarding her home.

stories.title: Cazas de Finlandia y Suecia interceptan a un escuadrón de aviones rusos en el Báltico

en.title: Fighter jets from Finland and Sweden intercept a Russian squadron of aircraft in the Baltic
en.summary: Finnish and Swedish jets intercepted a Russian patrol formation over the Baltic Sea comprising a Tu-134 transport aircraft and an unspecified number of MiG-31 and Su-30 fighter aircraft.

stories.title: El juez deja en libertad al cerebro financiero del 'caso Plus Ultra'

en.title: Judge releases financial mastermind of 'Plus Ultra case'
en.summary: Simon Lendeert Verhoeven, a key figure in the Plus Ultra case, has been released but faces restrictions including a travel ban on Spain, mandatory court appearances every two days, and requirement to maintain a fixed residence.

stories.title: Los estudiantes de Harvard acorralan a Sánchez con preguntas sobre Begoña Gómez y Pegasus

en.title: Harvard students corner Sánchez with questions about Begoña Gómez and Pegasus
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez was questioned by Harvard students during a conference on artificial intelligence regulation, with inquiries focusing on controversial domestic matters rather than his stated topic.

stories.title: Maricarmen, desde el Gregorio Marañón: “No he logrado defender mi casa, pero sí he luchado para que los demás aprendan”

en.title: Maricarmen, from Gregorio Marañón: "I have not managed to defend my house, but I have fought for others to learn"
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman evicted on Wednesday is recovering in a hospital, accompanied by her cousin, while expressing determination that her experience serves as a lesson for others.

stories.title: Cazas de Finlandia y Suecia interceptan aviones de guerra rusos sobre el Báltico

en.title: Finnish and Swedish fighter jets intercept Russian military aircraft over the Baltic
en.summary: Fighter aircraft from Finland and Sweden intercepted a Russian formation comprising a Tu-134 transport plane and an unspecified number of fighter jets over the Baltic region.

stories.title: Maricarmen agradece el apoyo desde el hospital: “No he logrado defender mi casa, pero sí he luchado”

en.title: Maricarmen thanks supporters from hospital: "I have not managed to defend my house, but I have fought"
en.summary: An elderly woman expresses gratitude to the Tenants' Union and her lawyer for their support during her situation.

stories.title: Tailandia desestima los recursos y mantiene la cadena perpetua para Daniel Sancho

en.title: Thailand rejects appeals and upholds life sentence for Daniel Sancho
en.summary: Thai courts dismiss the defense appeal and reject increased compensation for the parents of Edwin Arrieta, finding no need for additional evidence.

stories.title: Tailandia mantiene la cadena perpetua a Daniel Sancho

en.title: Thailand maintains life sentence for Daniel Sancho
en.summary: Thai courts dismiss the defense appeal and uphold the life sentence conviction for the premeditated murder of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta.

stories.title: Daniel Sancho seguirá cumpliendo cadena perpetua en Tailandia

en.title: Daniel Sancho will continue serving life sentence in Thailand
en.summary: The Samui Provincial Court dismisses the defense appeal requesting a retrial, while a ruling on the prosecution's death penalty appeal is pending for October 7.

stories.title: Qué hay detrás de la montaña rusa de Solaria en el Ibex

en.title: What's behind Solaria's roller coaster on the Ibex
en.summary: Solaria experiences significant stock market volatility, with sharp swings intensified by recent results and sustained selling pressure. Two major sources of uncertainty remain unresolved.

stories.title: El Ibex mejora para salvar la semana

en.title: The Ibex improves to save the week
en.summary: Iran's proposed truce with the United States and declining oil prices ease selling pressure on markets. The Ibex rebounds from two days of losses and works toward a positive weekly balance.

stories.title: Cuáles son las dos estrellas energéticas para ganar en Bolsa hasta un 27%

en.title: What are the two energy stars to gain up to 27% on the stock market
en.summary: An analysis firm believes the market underprices the outlook for utilities. It identifies Iberdrola and EDP Renováveis as preferred investments in the sector due to their strong balance sheets and financial stability.

stories.title: Oracle, obligada a pagar a los inversores del centro de datos aunque aún no tiene electricidad

en.title: Oracle obligated to pay investors for data center despite still lacking electricity
en.summary: Oracle must make payments for its Jupiter Project despite declaring force majeure on the New Mexico facility, which remains without power.

stories.title: Los Benetton se refuerzan en España al invertir en la vasca Celesa

en.title: The Benettons strengthen their position in Spain by investing in Basque company Celesa
en.summary: The Benetton group acquires Celesa, a Basque company specializing in professional cutting and hand tools, for 100 million euros, reinforcing its presence in Spain.
